intro:
You settle the terms of a data processing setup from legal notices, contracts, vendor sheets, an FAQ and emails.

Initial specification:
- [e001] Precedence rule: when sources disagree, the order of authority is legal-notice > contract > vendor-sheet > faq > email. Inside one source, the higher version wins.
- [e002] According to contract CTR-1 version 1, the data residency region is `ch-zone`.
- [e003] According to contract CTR-1 version 1, the default currency is `CHF`.
- [e004] The contract document CTR-1 (version 1) states that the maximum payload size in KB is `2048`.
- [e005] According to contract CTR-1 version 1, the export file format is `parquet`.
- [e006] According to contract CTR-1 version 1, the strict validation mode is `OFF`.
- [e007] The contract document CTR-1 (version 1) states that the session timeout in minutes is `15`.
- [e008] The vendor-sheet document VS-103 (version 2) states that the API rate limit per minute is `100`.

Sources, from highest to lowest authority: legal-notice, contract, vendor-sheet, faq, email. When two sources disagree, the higher one decides.
Inside one source, a higher version number overrides a lower one. A withdrawn document no longer counts at all.
Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
